description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
